problem_text:
A regional sales representative must conduct in-person visits to six corporate offices scattered across the territory.

The travel times between offices are as follows:
* Office Alpha to Beta: 126.3 minutes
* Alpha to Gamma: 36.9 minutes
* Alpha to Delta: 46.1 minutes
* Alpha to Epsilon: 86.8 minutes
* Alpha to Zeta: 63.2 minutes
* Beta to Gamma: 157.3 minutes
* Beta to Delta: 171.4 minutes
* Beta to Epsilon: 166.4 minutes
* Beta to Zeta: 71.7 minutes
* Gamma to Delta: 36.2 minutes
* Gamma to Epsilon: 108.2 minutes
* Gamma to Zeta: 88.1 minutes
* Delta to Epsilon: 79.7 minutes
* Delta to Zeta: 109.0 minutes
* Epsilon to Zeta: 132.4 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient itinerary that allows the representative to stop at each office precisely once before concluding the circuit back at the initial departure point.
